question: In which of the following states was the International Paragliding Festival organised by the Adventure Sports and Sustainable Tourism Academy (ASSTA) in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The International Paragliding Festival was organised by the Adventure Sports and Sustainable Tourism Academy (ASSTA) in Vagamom, **Kerala**__ in 2020.
 
• The festival is organized by the tourism department of Kerala in association with ASSTA.
 
• It is held mostly during the months of March-April.
 
• **Vagamon is identified as the most potential destination for paragliding in Asia**.
 
• It is situated at the border of the Kottayam and Idukki districts of Kerala.
 
• The low hills, rocky terrain and flatlands of Western Ghats provide ideal conditions for paragliding.
 
• Additionally, the vision of ASSTA is to promote adventure sports as a supplementary tourism product.
 
• It wants to establish tourism industries and communities that resolutely promote knowledge-based and sustainable tourism development and undertaking.
